annotations.title: Turn Autopilot on, off or paused

description: Turn Autopilot on, off or paused. On means real applications go out in the person's name without asking each time, so it is meant for their explicit instruction. Held with a summary first. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

confirmation_token.description: The token from a held answer, sent with exactly the same other inputs once the person has agreed to its summary.
